name: Shirakawa Akari
source:
Likes: Listening to music, shopping for clothes
Dislikes: Her father, rainy days

Tohoku University, First year at Faculty of Economics. Originally from Matsuoka Academy.

Due to family circumstances, she does part-time jobs to pay her own school tuition. 
Since she has no time on making friends, she became someone presence is a bit cut off.

Her tone expression is cool, and has a conservation view.

She has been friends with Erika since middle school. 
However, it seems that she can't face Erika with pure feelings recently. 

"First time doing it with someone other than your lover... what do you think of it?"
